input: Change: .github/workflows/lint.yml now has a paths filter so it runs only when files under src/ or tests/ change. Saves about 6 minutes of runner time on every docs-only PR. Job name unchanged. A nightly full lint run was considered and dropped.
wrong:
chore: add paths filter to lint.yml

Only src/ and tests/ trigger it and this saves 16 minutes on docs PRs.

feat: run lint on every change

lint.yml paths filter removed for src/ and tests/.

chore: add paths filter to lint.yml

Only src/ and tests/ trigger it, which saves 6 minutes on docs PRs, and it adds a nightly full run.
correct_alts:
chore: limit the lint workflow to code changes

lint.yml gets a paths filter for src/ and tests/, so documentation-only pull requests skip it and save around six minutes.

chore: skip lint on docs-only PRs

With a paths list covering src/ and tests/ in lint.yml, the job no longer runs for other edits. Each docs PR saves 6 minutes.
